python-tests.notes: Use the native dev extras and workflow runtime. No browser dependency is inferred from the existence of a web UI.

docker.notes: Requires an explicitly authorized usable build engine, not merely a client binary. Registry publishing credentials are a separate protected binding.

container-package.notes: The Dockerfile owns image/runtime selection. Declaring this capability never grants Docker socket access or publishing permissions.

application-runtime.notes: Application secrets, owner data and durable /data storage are private deployment bindings, not source build prerequisites.
